page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features an x86_64 CPU architecture configured with 2 dedicated physical cores and 1 thread per core, providing a total of 2 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 4.0 GB of RAM per physical core.

This instance does not include local storage or integrated GPU hardware, requiring reliance on network-attached storage options for persistent data. Additionally, the CPU configuration lacks support for advanced instruction sets, including Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-accelerated cryptography standards such as AES and SHA_NI. These omissions represent a tradeoff, limiting the instance's efficiency for vector-heavy mathematics, machine learning inference, and hardware-accelerated encryption tasks.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.s2.xlarge is structured for entry-level general-purpose workloads. It is appropriate for lightweight web serving, basic application hosting, and development environments that do not require specialized hardware acceleration or high-speed local disk I/O. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated core allocation provides predictable compute performance for standard utility workloads without the overhead of high-tier compute or memory-optimized hardware.
